geographic_notes.text: Southern Belize; Toledo District: May 2024 wildfires damaged Maya forests and farms in southern Belize, threatening food and cash-income sources.
Southern Belize: Maya communities organized relief and replanting; the account emphasizes customary governance, local training and Indigenous knowledge in fire management.
Belize barrier reef; Belize coast: Belize's reef and mangroves support fisheries, tourism and coastal protection; bleaching and reduced fish catch affect coastal livelihoods.
Belize coast: Marine adaptation combined ecosystem protection with alternative-livelihood training to reduce dependence on fishing.
Sarteneja: In Sarteneja, vocational training helped a fishing family pursue tourism-related work alongside seasonal fishing restrictions.
